title: 1 Enoch 74 — The moon's irregular cycle and the 354-day lunar year

translation.sourceText: 1 Enoch Astronomical Book (Book of the Luminaries / Sefer ha-Mazzalot) — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Aramaic DSS 4Q208-4Q211, OLDEST surviving Enoch material late 3rd c. paragraphs.text: ወካዕበ፡ ሑረታ፡ ካልዕተ፡ አርአየኒ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ወሕገገ፡ ሑረቶሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለበበ፡ ወርኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kāʿba ḥuratā kāləʿta ʾarʾayanī la-warḫ wa-ḥəgaga ḥuratomu kwəlo ḥəgaga laba-warḫ

i18n.en: And again he showed me another course of the moon, and the laws of their courses — all the laws month by month.

paragraphs.text: ወኵሉ፡ ሕገጊሆሙ፡ አርአየኒ፡ ኦሪኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ምስሌየ፡ ወከመ፡ ይከውን፡ ለቀዋምቶሙ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ጸሐፍኩ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kwəlu ḥəgagihomu ʾarʾayanī ʾUrʾēl malʾak qəddus zahallo məslēya wa-kama yəkawwən la-qawāmtomu səmātihomu ṣaḥafku

i18n.en: And Uriel, the holy angel who was with me, showed me all their laws; and I wrote down their names according to their stations, as they are.

paragraphs.text: ወጸሐፈ፡ ሊተ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ዘበበ፡ ወርኆሙ፡ ወዘበበ፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ እስከ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ በበ፡ ዐሥር፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ṣaḥafa lita manbaromu zababa warḫomu wa-zababa bərhānomu ʾəska yətfēṣam baba ʿaśr wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt

i18n.en: And he wrote down for me their stations, month by month, and the increase of their light, until it is completed in fourteen days.

paragraphs.text: በስብዐቱ፡ ቀዳምያን፡ መንበራት፡ ለብርሃና፡ ምሉአ፡ ብርሃና፡ ይከውን፡ በበ፡ ስብዕ፡ ምክፋላት፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-səbʿatu qadāməyān manbarāt la-bərhānā məluʾa bərhānā yəkawwən baba səbʿ məkəfālāt

i18n.en: In the seven first stations of her light her light becomes full, according to seven parts.

paragraphs.text: ወይትገብኡ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ስብዐቱ፡ መንበራት፡ ዘስብዐቱ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ለብርሃና፡ በምዕራባት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətgabbəʾu kiyāhu səbʿatu manbarāt zasəbʿatu məkəfālāt la-bərhānā ba-məʿrābāt

i18n.en: And the seven stations of her light, by seven parts, return again in the western places.

paragraphs.text: ወእለሰ፡ ቀዋምት፡ ዘይትፈለጡ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኩሎሙ፡ ሕገጊሆሙ፡ በበ፡ ወርኆሙ፡ ወበበ፡ ዓመቶሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəlasa qawāmt zayətfaḷaṭu lāʿla kwəlomu ḥəgagihomu baba warḫomu wa-baba ʿāmatomu

i18n.en: And the stations are distinguished according to all their laws, month by month and year by year.

paragraphs.text: ወያመጽእ፡ ወይትገብእ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ መንበር፡ በአንቀጽ፡ ዘይትፈለጥ፡ ሰማንየ፡ ዕለታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yāmaṣṣəʾ wa-yətgabbəʾ la-ḍaḥay qadāmāwi manbar ba-ʾanqaḍ zayətfaḷaṭ samānya ʿəlatāt

i18n.en: And he brings and returns to the sun its first station through the gate which is separated by eight days.

paragraphs.text: ወአናቅጽ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ፀሐይ፡ የሐውር፡ በውስቴቶሙ፡ ለሠላሳ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ምስለ፡ መራኅት፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanāqəḍ ʾəmənnehomu yəwaḍḍəʾ ḍaḥay yaḥawwər ba-wəstētomu la-śallāsā mawāʿəla məsla marāḫət laba-gizēhu

i18n.en: And there are the gates from which the sun comes forth; the sun travels through them for thirty days, together with the leaders, each in its time.

paragraphs.text: ותרעיא די מנהון יפק שהרא שתא תרעין הוין מהלכה לשהרא ומן מהלכיהון תוב יתוב
paragraphs.translit: wě-tarʿayyāʾ dī minhōn yippōq sahrāʾ šittāʾ tarʿīn hāwēn mahălkah lě-sahrāʾ ū-min mahălkayhōn tūb yětūb

i18n.en: And the gates through which the moon comes forth — there are six gates; they are the moon's course, and from their courses she again returns.

paragraphs.commentary: **Aramaic-PRIMARY witness.** This verse is preserved in the Aramaic 4Q209 fragment in a fuller form than the Ge'ez transmission preserves elsewhere in ch 74; the WoH translation prefers the Aramaic where preserved per the per-verse layered-witness convention. The six-gates-of-the-moon framework parallels the six-gates-of-the-sun framework of ch 72 (six eastern + six western gates); the lunar gates participate in the same cosmographic-cardinal-gate framework but with the moon's distinct monthly cycle. See central entry `astronomical-book-1-enoch-72-82-aramaic-dss-oldest-witness-unit-entry`.

paragraphs.text: ወእም፡ ሐመሰ፡ ምክፋላተ፡ ዕለታት፡ ዓመተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ስድሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ መዋዕል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəm-ḥammasa məkəfālāta ʿəlatāt ʿāmata ḍaḥay yətfēṣam śallastu məʾət sədsā wa-ʾarbāʿtu mawāʿəl

i18n.en: And by the fifth portion of days, the solar year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.

paragraphs.text: ויחסר שנת סיהרא עשרה יומין מן שנת שמשא ויהוה תלת מאה חמשין וארבעה יומין
paragraphs.translit: wě-yiḥsar šěnat sahrāʾ ʿaśrāh yōmīn min šěnat šimšāʾ wě-yěhěwēh tělāt měʾāh ḥamšīn wě-ʾarbāʿ yōmīn

i18n.en: And the lunar year falls short of the solar year by ten days, and it amounts to three hundred and fifty-four days.

paragraphs.commentary: **The 354-vs-364 day-gap — Aramaic-PRIMARY witness.** This verse explicitly states the 10-day gap between the solar year (364 days) and the lunar year (354 days, that is, 12 × 29.5 = 354 synodic-month-days). The verse is preserved in the Aramaic 4Q209 fragment; the Aramaic preserves the calendrical-gap statement in fuller form than the Ge'ez. The 10-day gap is one of the central mathematical-problems of the Astronomical Book: the solar 364-day calendar (the calendrical-identity-keystone of the Qumran-Enochic-Jubilees corpus) and the lunar 354-day calendar (the proto-Rabbinic / Pharisaic Temple-Establishment framework) accumulate a 10-day-per-year discrepancy that the Astronomical Book preserves without an explicit harmonization-system. See central entry `qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: ወይትገብኡ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ ለማእክለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓመታት፡ ምስለ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ቅዱም፡ ወይትኀደጉ፡ ዘበጊዜሆሙ፡ አርባዕተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዘኢተሐስቡ፡ በኆለቅ፡ ለዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətgabbəʾu ḍaḥay wa-kawākəbt la-māʾəkla kwəlu ʿāmatāt məsla manbaromu qəddum wa-yətḫaddagu zababa gizēhomu ʾarbāʿta mawāʿəla zaʾitaḥasabu ba-ḫolaq la-ʿāmat

i18n.en: And the sun and the stars return to their former stations in the midst of all the years; and there are left over, in their season, four days which are not counted in the reckoning of the year.

paragraphs.text: ወአርባዕተ፡ ዓመተ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ አሐደ፡ ሺህ፡ ወአርባዕተ፡ ምእተ፡ ሰብዐ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዓመተ፡ ፀሐይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿta ʿāmata yətfēṣam ʾaḥada śiḥ wa-ʾarbāʿta məʾəta sabʿa mawāʿəla ʿāmata ḍaḥay

i18n.en: And in four years the solar year is completed at one thousand four hundred and seventy days.

paragraphs.text: ወአርባዕተ፡ ዓመተ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ አሐደ፡ ሺህ፡ ወምእተ፡ ስድሳ፡ ወሰላሳ፡ ወክልኤተ፡ መዋዕለ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿta ʿāmata la-warḫ yətfēṣam ʾaḥada śiḥ wa-məʾəta sədsā wa-salāsā wa-kəlʾēta mawāʿəla

i18n.en: And in four years the lunar year is completed at one thousand four hundred and thirty-two days.

paragraphs.text: ወይትፌጸም፡ ቅያስ፡ በውስተ፡ ሣልስ፡ ዓመት፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ስድሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወእምነ፡ ወርኅ፡ ይትኄፀጽ፡ ሰላሳ፡ መዋዕል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətfēṣam qəyās ba-wəsta śāləs ʿāmat śallastu məʾət sədsā wa-ʾarbāʿtu mawāʿəl wa-ʾəmənna warḫ yətḫēḍaṣ salāsā mawāʿəl

i18n.en: And the reckoning is completed in the third year at three hundred and sixty-four days; and the moon falls short by thirty days.

paragraphs.text: ወይከውን፡ በሣልስ፡ ዓመት፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ሰላሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ መዋዕል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəkawwən ba-śāləs ʿāmat śallastu məʾət salāsā wa-ʾarbāʿtu mawāʿəl

i18n.en: And in the third year it becomes three hundred and thirty-four days.

paragraphs.text: ወይትኄፀጽ፡ ዓመተ፡ ወርኅ፡ እምነ፡ ዓመተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ ናኦቶ፡ ሰላሳ፡ መዋዕል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətḫēḍaṣ ʿāmata warḫ ʾəmənna ʿāmata ḍaḥay wa-kawākəbt nāʾoto salāsā mawāʿəl

i18n.en: And the lunar year falls short of the year of the sun and the stars by the measure of thirty days.
